name: Nell
look: A wiry twelve-year-old girl with two long dark braids, a faded blue linen dress under a stained canvas apron, ink smudges on her fingers, a pencil stub behind one ear.
personality: Quick, bookish and bossy; reads everything; corrects her father's spelling and adores him.
values: knowing how things work, reading, being taken seriously
fears: being sent to her aunt's in the city, the dark
authority: Keeps the book and the accounts.
concerns: Her father works too hard; she wants someone to read the book with.

book_help.text: The book says how to make each thing.
book_help.line: It's all in the book! Rope's the easiest. Torch is messy.
book_help.lead: Odo's book says how to make the rope, the torch and the sling.

pitch_hot.text: Pitch is easier to work when it's warm from the hearth.
pitch_hot.line: Warm the pitch by the hearth first, it goes on better.
pitch_hot.lead: Pitch works better warmed by the hearth.

style: Precise and a little bossy; quotes the book; asks the stranger what they've read.

samples: It says right there on page two. Have you read it?
Can you read? Really? What's the longest book you ever read?
Don't touch the hearth, it bites.
voice.habits: Quotes the book; corrects small mistakes; asks about reading.
voice.greeting: Looks up from a page: 'Oh! Can you read?'

goals: Read every book in the valley

npc_odo_tinker.text: her father; the best tinker in the valley

superstition.text: Nell would want to know how it works.
